usage: The word '二頭肌' is a noun referring to the muscle group on the front of the upper arm.
'二頭肌' is used to talk about muscle development or body parts in fitness contexts.
You can use '二頭肌' to describe exercises that target this muscle, like bicep curls.
When describing your workout routine, you can say, '我今次訓練左二頭肌' (I trained my biceps this time).
'二頭肌' always refers to the same specific muscle group, so it is not used metaphorically.
